newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures slide lower on strong yen.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures slide lower on strong yen.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures saw choppy trading on Monday morning though volumes were thin, said dealers.
The index opened up following the strong close on Wall Street stocks on Friday but buying soon petered out, a dealer with a Japanese brokerage said.
Dealers said the selling was prompted by the falls in the cash market after the U.S. dollar weakened sharply against the yen, falling below 113 yen level.
"A strong yen is seen hurting Japanese exporters," the dealer said.
Traders also continued rolling over their positions to the September contract from June.
June Nikkei was down 200 points at 20,325 after opening at 20,540 at the end of the morning session. September was at 20,370 against its open at 20,630.
Dealers said the index was likely to end lower in the afternoon session but some support was seen around 20,200.
